info.name: FlutCloud
info.summary: Non-standard server features used by the FlutLink client
info.description:
FlutCloud is the companion Nextcloud app of the FlutLink desktop client. It provides the non-standard features the FlutLink client builds on and identifies the server as a FlutCloud instance via the OCS capabilities.
Features: - FlutCloud capability advertised over the OCS capabilities endpoint - Ping endpoint (verified by the FlutLink client before connecting) - Virtual links (read-only `resources` folders) and writable `parts` - Shared project folder `/FlutLink/FlutCloud` for the OperationFlut team
FlutLink connects exclusively to servers that run this app.
info.author: OperationFlut
